title: "Sound Machines"
subtitle: "The art, science and history of music technology, told from the signal's point of view."
toc: false
listing:
  id: timeline
  contents: milestones/*/index.qmd
  type: grid
  grid-columns: 4
  sort: "year asc"
  sort-ui: [year, date]
  filter-ui: false
  categories: false
  fields: [image, year, title, description, date]
  field-display-names:
    year: "Milestone"
    date: "Published"
  feed: false
---

```{=html}
<style>
/* Homepage only: widen the whole content column instead of Quarto's narrow
   reading column. main.content is a real grid item (grid-column:
   body-content-start/body-content-end), so re-pointing it at the full
   screen-start/screen-end track and re-centering it here genuinely works —
   its children (title block, paragraphs, listing) just fill it at 100%. */
#quarto-document-content {
  grid-column: screen-start / screen-end;
  width: 85vw;
  max-width: 85vw;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}

/* Title, subtitle, intro text, and the sort control: narrow to the width of
   the two center columns of the 4-column post grid below (same 1.5em grid
   gap), centered on the same axis as the wider 85vw content column.
   --sm-grid-span-2 is defined in signal.scss, which also gives post pages
   this same measure. */
#title-block-header,
#quarto-document-content > p,
.listing-actions-group {
  width: var(--sm-grid-span-2);
  max-width: var(--sm-grid-span-2);
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}

/* Holding half the content width all the way down leaves a narrowing window
   with more margin than text, so under 992px the text takes the whole content
   column instead. That is half of a 1984px screen, so a window halved from
   any usual size is already full width by the time it gets here.

   There is no useful step in between: a centered block only lines up with the
   card columns at two columns or at the full four, since an odd span centered
   in four sits half a column off the grid either side. Move this breakpoint
   down to 767.98px if the intro reads too wide in the 768-992px band. */
@media (max-width: 991.98px) {
  #title-block-header,
  #quarto-document-content > p,
  .listing-actions-group {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
  }
}

/* Post cards: keep year/date in the listing data (sort-ui needs them), but
   only show the title and description on the card itself. */
#listing-timeline .card-attribution,
#listing-timeline .card-other-values {
  display: none;
}
</style>
```

Each entry below is one milestone in the history of music technology: a
technique, a breakthrough, a machine. The story is told twice — once as
history, for anyone who loves music, and once as a signal, for anyone who
wants to know what actually happens to the sound.

Sort by *Milestone* to read chronologically, or by *Published* to see what's
new.

::: {#timeline}
